prompt: Write a descriptive timeline of the lore of the RDR franchise
judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: (1) Provide a descriptive timeline of RDR lore—Pass for all; (2) include/organize by time—Pass for all though 2/4 use incorrect years; (3) factual accuracy of major events/character details—Candidate 1 mostly correct, Candidates 2/3/4 have notable inaccuracies. Candidate 1 gives the most coherent, lore-consistent timeline with only minor questionable dating/details. Candidate 2 and 4 introduce multiple clearly incorrect or likely fabricated specifics (e.g., Arthur as a “lawyer,” wrong epilogue year for Jack, and Dutch “killed” instead of suicide; plus speculative claims about Jack’s 1915 duel/location and later novelist impact). Candidate 3 is comparatively more vague and includes at least one significant timeline mismatch (Revolver-to-RDR gap).
